basis: Direct information_schema inspection of Neon branch br-restless-base-b44cip2h on 2026-11-05

contextRequired.bilateral_scope: Explicitly authorized organization set for bilateral workflows, transaction-scoped
contextRequired.service_mode: Explicit non-request service/migrator context; never inferred from client headers

bwg_waste_reports.relationship: processor organization; inspect all other party/ownership columns before policy implementation

chain_of_custody_links.relationship: actor organization; access must follow chain-of-custody semantics

credentials.relationship: issuer organization; credential subject/holder semantics require separate policy review

epr_credit_transfers.relationship: bilateral transfer; authorized sender/receiver visibility must be defined

requiredPolicyTests: organization A cannot SELECT organization B rows
organization A cannot INSERT a row claiming organization B
organization A cannot UPDATE a row into organization B
organization A cannot DELETE organization B rows
multi-organization identity is restricted to selected active organization unless bilateral workflow explicitly permits both sides
revoked membership immediately loses database visibility
pooled connections cannot retain previous request's organization context
service/migrator context is explicit and cannot be supplied by ordinary API request headers
bilateral transfer/credential semantics do not accidentally broaden access
releaseRule: No production RLS enablement until this matrix is converted into reviewed SQL policies and all disposable PostgreSQL isolation tests pass.
